options_by_state.description: State Options Report dashboard: each state agency's selection on each policy option (not waivers or demonstration projects: use option_states or options_report). One row per state x policy option, with how many of the 53 agencies made the same selection. Editions 16 and 17.

state.desc: state agency name or USPS code, a list of them, or "all" (default: all 53)

option_states.description: State Options Report dashboard: the state agencies that made a selection on one option, waiver or demonstration project (one row per state x selection). Without selection: every selection of that policy, so each state appears once. Editions 16 and 17.

policy.desc: policy option, waiver or project: a catalog alias (bbce, abawd_waiver ...) or its exact name (--endpoints, --search)

selection.desc: one selection value of that policy, exactly as in the catalog entry (default: all of them)

options_report.description: State Options Report PDF (any edition, 1st 2002 to 17th 2025) as text: one row per page (edition, page, state for a state agency profile page, text). With state: only that agency's profile pages (editions 16 and 17 have one or two profile pages per agency). Needs the Python package pypdf.

state.desc: optional: one state agency name or USPS code; keeps its profile pages

pages.desc: optional: printed PDF page numbers, e.g. "9-12" or "44,45" (the PDF's own page index, 1 = cover)

activity_tables.description: SNAP State Activity Report state tables (FY 2019-2023) as tidy rows: report_fy, table, state, measure, data_fy, value (as published), value_num, value_flag. Table keys: source.md (and activity_tables in this file). Ranking tables and the national summary are not parsed (same numbers; read them with activity_report). Needs the Python package pypdf.

fiscal_year.desc: report fiscal year, 2019 to 2023 (a list is allowed)

tables.desc: table keys from the catalog (e.g. ["admin_costs", "persons_multiyear"]) or "all" (default)

state.desc: optional: state agency names or USPS codes to keep

activity_report.description: SNAP State Activity Report PDF (FY 2004-2023) as text: one row per page (report_fy, page, table title, text). For years activity_tables does not parse, or the national summary and ranking tables. Needs the Python package pypdf.

pages.desc: optional: PDF page numbers, e.g. "4" or "7-12"

program_table.description: FNA Program Data tables (XLSX, updated monthly): SNAP, WIC and child nutrition (school lunch, breakfast, milk, CACFP, summer meals) as tidy rows: table, table_title, data_as_of, state, state_abbr, agency, row_type, period, period_type, fiscal_year, measure, unit, value, value_num, value_flag, status, footnote. National annual summaries (FY 1969-), national monthly data (last four fiscal years), state tables by fiscal year (last five) and the latest three months by state. Table keys: the catalog (--endpoints, --search).

table.desc: a program table key from the catalog, e.g. snap_persons_latest, wic_participation_state, nslp_participation_state, nslp_annual

state.desc: optional (state tables only): states or territories to keep, USPS codes or names (AS, GU, MP, PR, VI for territories); national, total and DOD rows are dropped

fiscal_year.desc: optional: fiscal years to keep (one or a list)

snap_state_monthly.description: SNAP households, persons, benefits and benefit per household / person by state and month (FY 2020 to the latest month), with FNA region and U.S. rows and each fiscal year's total, from the SNAP data zip (snap-zip-fy69tocurrent). Same columns as program_table. Earlier years are old .xls files this pack does not read.

fiscal_year.desc: fiscal year(s), 2020 to the latest (one or a list)

state.desc: optional: states or territories to keep (USPS codes or names); region and U.S. rows are dropped

wic_agency_monthly.description: WIC participation by category (pregnant, breastfeeding and postpartum women, infants by feeding, children), food costs, rebates and NSA costs by WIC state agency, Indian tribal organization and FNA region, for each month of a fiscal year (FY 2022-, the latest preliminary), from wicagencies<FY>ytd.xlsx. Same columns as program_table.

fiscal_year.desc: fiscal year, 2022 to the latest (one a request)

measures.desc: sheet keys (wic_agency_sheets in endpoints.json; e.g. ["participants_total", "children"]) or "all" (default: participants_total)

state.desc: optional: states or territories to keep (USPS codes or names), with their tribal organizations

utility_expenses.description: policy option: mandatory standard utility allowances (SUAs)

self_employment_income.description: policy option (16th edition only): self-employment costs

noncitizens_pre_prwora.id: Treatment of Income and Deductions of Ineligible Noncitizens: Pre-PRWORA

selections: Count all for gross income test, then count all but a prorated share for net income test
Pre-PRWORA Count all but a prorated share

noncitizens_post_prwora.id: Treatment of Income and Deductions of Ineligible Noncitizens: Post-PRWORA

employment_training.id: Voluntary and Mandatory SNAP Employment and Training Programs
employment_training.description: policy option (17th edition in the dashboard; the 16th edition PDF has it): voluntary and/or mandatory SNAP E&T

work_disqualification_period.description: policy option: disqualification periods for failing work requirements
selections: Extended disqualification periods and permanent disqualification after third instance of noncompliance

work_disqualify_household.id: Work Requirements: Option to Disqualify the Entire Household
work_disqualify_household.description: policy option: disqualify the whole household when the head fails work requirements (wording differs by edition: entire / whole)
selections: Disqualify only the individual who fails to comply
Disqualify the entire household if the head of household fails to comply
Disqualify the whole household if the head of household fails to comply

child_support_disqualifications.description: policy option: disqualification for failure to cooperate with child support (the name has an en dash)
selections: Failure to cooperate: disqualification for custodial parent
Failure to cooperate: disqualification for custodial and noncustodial parent
Failure to cooperate: disqualification for custodial and noncustodial parent and arrearage on support payments
Failure to cooperate: disqualification for noncustodial parent and arrearage on support payments

comparable_disqualifications.description: policy option: disqualify SNAP for a comparable sanction in another program

drug_felony.description: policy option: drug felony ban (lifetime, modified or none)

tba.description: policy option: transitional benefits for households leaving TANF

abawd_exemptions.description: policy option: use of ABAWD discretionary exemptions

pledge_states.description: policy option (17th edition): pledge to offer E&T slots to at-risk ABAWDs

abawd_waiver.description: waiver: ABAWD time limit waiver (statewide, partial or none)

selections: No waiver to accept pre-release applications

elderly_recert_interview_waiver.id: Recertification Interview for Elderly or Disabled Households Waiver
elderly_recert_interview_waiver.description: waiver (17th edition): no recertification interview for elderly or disabled households

shorten_certification_waiver.id: Shorten Certification Periods for Certain Households Waiver
selections: Waiver to shorten certification periods for certain households
No waiver to shorten certification periods for certain households

text_alerts_waiver.id: Text Message Alerts (for Electronic Notices) Waiver
text_alerts_waiver.description: waiver (17th edition): text message alerts only for electronic notices
selections: Send text message alerts only (for Electronic Notices) waiver
No send text message alerts only (for Electronic Notices) waiver
